name: Eyebrow shaping
description: Professional eyebrow shaping using the African razor technique to create clean, defined brows that complement your face shape. Perfect for maintaining a neat, natural look.

name: Ombré brows
description:
Our Ombre Brow technique creates a soft, powdered look, similar to a perfectly filled-in brow with makeup. This method gives a gradient effect, starting lighter at the front and darker towards the tail, enhancing your natural shape with flawless definition.

✔ Long-Lasting Results – Enjoy beautifully shaded brows for 2-3 years.
✔ No Daily Makeup Needed – Wake up with perfect, ready-to-go brows!
✔ Gentle & Ideal for All Skin Types – Works beautifully for oily, dry, and sens

name: Combo brows
description:
Our Combo Brows combines microblading and microshading techniques. Hair-like strokes in the front create a natural look, and soft shading throughout adds definition and fullness. This technique is perfect for those who want a realistic yet polished brow with long-lasting results.

✔ Natural strokes + soft shading for a flawless finish.
✔ Lasts 2-3 Years – Wake up with perfect brows every day!
✔ Customizable Shape & Color.
✔ Great for All Skin Types
✔ Minimal Discomfort, No Downtime

name: Brow Touch-Up – Keep Your Brows Looking Fresh & Flawless.
description: Refresh your brows with a touch-up to maintain their colour and shape. This service is for existing semi-permanent brow clients. Price is £95 for brows originally done at Sandy Beauty Haven. If your brows were done by another artist, an additional £25 assessment fee applies (total £110). Please send clear photos before booking, as not all previous work is suitable for a touch-up.

name: EXPRESS LASHES
description: perfect for busy girlies who want beautiful lashes in 30 minutes or less. Ideal for last-minute appointments, holidays, special occasions, date nights, or when you simply need a quick beauty refresh. Enjoy a lightweight, gorgeous lash look that lasts 7–10 days with proper aftercare. Fast, convenient, and effortlessly beautiful.

name: Classic lashes
description: A single eyelash extension applied one to one with the natural lash. It a natural set and can only be as full as your natural lashes

name: Hybrid lash extensions
description: a mix of classic extensions and handmade volume fans creating a light fluffy look. Perfect if you are struggling on deciding a set.

name: Light Volume lashes ( light Russian)
description: Perfect for clients who want more fullness than a Hybrid set while maintaining a soft, fluffy, and lightweight finish. Fully customizable to your desired lash style

name: Mega Volume/Russian
description: Perfect for clients who love bold, dark, and glamorous lashes with maximum fullness. Our Mega Russian Volume set creates a dense, fluffy look that makes a statement. Fully customizable to your desired style

name: Wispy set
description: Wispy Volume set gives the appearance of a False Strip Lashes & Kardashian look. Wispy Eyelash Extensions Volume Full Set are suitable for clients who desire a Spikey False Lash Look

name: Customized lash set
description:
The service is base on clients preference, You tell us  your desired lash style, preferably lash length and design.

name: Beginner lash course
description: Kickstart your lash career with our 3-Day Beginner Lash Course. Perfect for complete beginners, you’ll learn lash theory, health & safety, client consultation, classic lash application, lash mapping, isolation, infills, removal, aftercare, pricing, and business tips. Includes a professional starter kit, training manual, live model practice, certificate, and ongoing support. No experience needed—leave confident and ready to take clients.

name: Soft Glam
description: A soft, elegant makeup look that enhances your natural beauty. Perfect for birthdays, brunches, graduations, dinners, and everyday glamour. Includes strip lashes if desired.

name: Full Glam Makeup
description: A flawless full-coverage glam with defined eyes, sculpted skin, and a long-lasting finish. Perfect for parties, events, weddings, and special occasions. Includes strip lashes.
